SELECT
    t1.person_id,
    c_condition.concept_name AS condition_name,
    'Drug' AS treatment_type,
    c_drug.concept_name AS treatment_name,
    de.drug_era_start_date AS treatment_date
FROM
    condition_era AS t1
JOIN
    concept AS c_condition ON t1.condition_concept_id = c_condition.concept_id
JOIN
    drug_era AS de ON t1.person_id = de.person_id
JOIN
    concept AS c_drug ON de.drug_concept_id = c_drug.concept_id
WHERE
    t1.condition_concept_id IN (778711, 1112807, 1115008, 1125315, 1177480, 1506270)

UNION ALL

SELECT
    t1.person_id,
    c_condition.concept_name AS condition_name,
    'Procedure' AS treatment_type,
    c_procedure.concept_name AS treatment_name,
    po.procedure_date AS treatment_date
FROM
    condition_era AS t1
JOIN
    concept AS c_condition ON t1.condition_concept_id = c_condition.concept_id
JOIN
    procedure_occurrence AS po ON t1.person_id = po.person_id
JOIN
    concept AS c_procedure ON po.procedure_concept_id = c_procedure.concept_id
WHERE
    t1.condition_concept_id IN (778711, 1112807, 1115008, 1125315, 1177480, 1506270)
;

args.sql_query:
WITH ConditionCohort AS (
    -- Identify the specific condition and its descendants
    -- Placeholder: Using Concept ID 439061 for "Disease" as an example.
    -- This must be replaced with a user-approved condition concept ID for a real study.
    SELECT
        ca.descendant_concept_id AS condition_concept_id
    FROM
        concept_ancestor ca
    WHERE
        ca.ancestor_concept_id = 439061 -- Example: "Disease" Concept ID
),
PatientConditions AS (
    -- Select patient conditions matching the defined cohort, ensuring Standard concepts
    SELECT
        co.person_id,
        co.condition_occurrence_id,
        co.condition_start_date,
        c.concept_name AS condition_name
    FROM
        condition_occurrence co
    JOIN
        ConditionCohort cc_ids ON co.condition_concept_id = cc_ids.condition_concept_id
    JOIN
        concept c ON co.condition_concept_id = c.concept_id
    WHERE
        c.standard_concept = 'S'
),
PatientTreatments AS (
    -- Collect all relevant drug exposures for each patient and condition episode
    SELECT
        pc.person_id,
        pc.condition_occurrence_id,
        pc.condition_name,
        pc.condition_start_date,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT d_concept.concept_name, '; ' ORDER BY d_concept.concept_name) AS drug_schemes
    FROM
        PatientConditions pc
    JOIN
        drug_exposure de ON pc.person_id = de.person_id
    JOIN
        concept d_concept ON de.drug_concept_id = d_concept.concept_id
    WHERE
        de.drug_exposure_start_date >= pc.condition_start_date
        AND de.drug_exposure_start_date <= DATE_ADD(pc.condition_start_date, INTERVAL 365 DAY) -- Treatments within 365 days
        AND d_concept.standard_concept = 'S'
    GROUP BY
        pc.person_id, pc.condition_occurrence_id, pc.condition_name, pc.condition_start_date
),
PatientProcedures AS (
    -- Collect all relevant procedures for each patient and condition episode
    SELECT
        pc.person_id,
        pc.condition_occurrence_id,
        pc.condition_name,
        pc.condition_start_date,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p_concept.concept_name, '; ' ORDER BY p_concept.concept_name) AS procedure_schemes
    FROM
        PatientConditions pc
    JOIN
        procedure_occurrence po ON pc.person_id = po.person_id
    JOIN
        concept p_concept ON po.procedure_concept_id = p_concept.concept_id
    WHERE
        po.procedure_date >= pc.condition_start_date
        AND po.procedure_date <= DATE_ADD(pc.condition_start_date, INTERVAL 365 DAY) -- Procedures within 365 days
        AND p_concept.standard_concept = 'S'
    GROUP BY
        pc.person_id, pc.condition_occurrence_id, pc.condition_name, pc.condition_start_date
)
-- Final aggregation of treatment schemes
SELECT
    pt.condition_name,
    COALESCE(pt.drug_schemes, 'No Drugs') AS drugs_used,
    COALESCE(pp.procedure_schemes, 'No Procedures') AS procedures_performed,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pt.person_id) AS number_of_patients_with_this_scheme,
    COUNT(*) AS scheme_occurrences
FROM
    PatientTreatments pt
FULL OUTER JOIN
    PatientProcedures pp ON pt.person_id = pp.person_id
                         AND pt.condition_occurrence_id = pp.condition_occurrence_id
                         AND pt.condition_name = pp.condition_name
                         AND pt.condition_start_date = pp.condition_start_date
GROUP BY
    pt.condition_name, drugs_used, procedures_performed
ORDER BY
    scheme_occurrences DESC
LIMIT 100;

    JOIN

),
PatientTreatments AS (
    -- Recopila todas las exposiciones a fármacos relevantes para cada paciente y episodio de condición.
    -- Agrupa los fármacos administrados para formar una cadena que representa el "esquema" de fármacos.
    SELECT
        pc.person_id,
        pc.condition_occurrence_id,
        pc.condition_name,
        pc.condition_start_date,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT d_concept.concept_name, '; ' ORDER BY d_concept.concept_name) AS drug_schemes
    FROM
        PatientConditions pc
    JOIN
        drug_exposure de ON pc.person_id = de.person_id
    JOIN
        concept d_concept ON de.drug_concept_id = d_concept.concept_id
    WHERE
        de.drug_exposure_start_date >= pc.condition_start_date
        AND de.drug_exposure_start_date <= DATE_ADD(pc.condition_start_date, INTERVAL 365 DAY) -- Fármacos dentro de los 365 días posteriores al diagnóstico
        AND d_concept.standard_concept = 'S'
    GROUP BY
        pc.person_id, pc.condition_occurrence_id, pc.condition_name, pc.condition_start_date
),
PatientProcedures AS (
    -- Recopila todos los procedimientos relevantes para cada paciente y episodio de condición.
    -- Agrupa los procedimientos realizados para formar una cadena que representa el "esquema" de procedimientos.
    SELECT
        pc.person_id,
        pc.condition_occurrence_id,
        pc.condition_name,
        pc.condition_start_date,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p_concept.concept_name, '; ' ORDER BY p_concept.concept_name) AS procedure_schemes
    FROM
        PatientConditions pc
    JOIN
        procedure_occurrence po ON pc.person_id = po.person_id
    JOIN
        concept p_concept ON po.procedure_concept_id = p_concept.concept_id
    WHERE

        AND p_concept.standard_concept = 'S'
    GROUP BY
        pc.person_id, pc.condition_occurrence_id, pc.condition_name, pc.condition_start_date
)
-- Agregación final de los esquemas de tratamiento, categorizando y contando las combinaciones.
SELECT
    COALESCE(pt.condition_name, pp.condition_name) AS condition_name,
    COALESCE(pt.drug_schemes, 'No Drugs') AS drugs_used,
    COALESCE(pp.procedure_schemes, 'No Procedures') AS procedures_performed,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(pt.person_id, pp.person_id)) AS number_of_patients_with_this_scheme,

FROM

FULL OUTER JOIN
    PatientProcedures pp ON pt.person_id = pp.person_id
                         AND pt.condition_occurrence_id = pp.condition_occurrence_id
                         AND pt.condition_name = pp.condition_name
                         AND pt.condition_start_date = pp.condition_start_date
GROUP BY

ORDER BY
